aria: Animated recap of the Hawks' 111 to 97 home win over the Hornets: Jalen Johnson's dunk and free throw off a Dyson Daniels steal with 4:35 left in the third quarter that made it 76 to 69, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Johnson's 26 points and four steals, the top scorers, how the Hawks won, and the next game.

notes: Box score from the Hawks' 111–97 home win over the Charlotte Hornets on Nov 20, 2026, from the Covers box score, checked against the Associated Press, Field Level Media, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution and Ball Exclusives. Covers lists Nickeil Alexander-Walker with 19 points (and Atlanta with 113), but his own line (7 of 20, 2 of 8 from three, 1 of 1 free throws) adds up to 17, which the AP, Field Level Media, the AJC and Ball Exclusives all report; with 17, all 111 Atlanta points and all 97 Charlotte points are accounted for. The quarter scores (23–33–31–24 to 31–26–19–21) add up to both totals: Charlotte led 57–56 at the half and Atlanta led 87–76 after three. Points in the paint (56–50), fast-break points (21–10), steals (12–4), rebounds (37–49) and both biggest leads (Atlanta 19, Charlotte 14) are from the Covers box score; points off turnovers (36–16) are from the AP. Moussa Diabate's 15 rebounds are from Covers, Field Level Media and Ball Exclusives (the AP says 14). Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Friday's games.

Atlanta won its third straight game and is 2–1 in NBA Cup group play; Charlotte lost its fourth straight and is 0–3 (AP; Field Level Media). Charlotte led by 14 at 50–36 in the second quarter before a 12–0 Atlanta run, eight points of it by Jalen Johnson (Field Level Media; AP). Johnson's 26 points came on 10 of 15 shooting with four steals; Dyson Daniels added 11 points, 10 assists, 8 rebounds and 4 steals (box score; AP). Atlanta won the first meeting 128–81 at Charlotte on Oct. 23 (AP; Basketball-Reference). The Hawks host Detroit on Sunday, Nov 22 at 3:30 PM ET, the first meeting of the season (Ball Exclusives; SI schedule).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Jalen Johnson's three-point play with 4:35 left in the third quarter that made it 76–69 (Field Level Media: "Atlanta took a 76-69 lead on Johnson's three-point play with 4:35 left in the third quarter"; AP: "a steal by Daniels set up a jam by Johnson for a 76-69 lead"; Peachtree Hoops via Yahoo: "the dunk plus the foul"). The board's 73–69 before the play follows from the three-point play. The template draws it as a finish at the rim after a run up the floor; the dunk itself and the steal are not animated, and no source says which side of the floor it came from. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Atlanta Hawks or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Jalen Johnson's listed 6-foot-8 and 219 pounds with No. 1 (Basketball-Reference; Wikipedia), with his arms scaled to a 7-foot-¼ wingspan measured at the 2021 draft combine (The Kings Herald). He is drawn in Atlanta's home white with the default figure look (no approved look yet). It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
